L can reach 3 of the 5 kinds. Each reachable place I kill from gets constrained after 3 successful traces: x0.25 (docket x0.2). I can afford 2 constrained places: 55000*.25*.25=3437 or *.2=2750. A 3rd constraint means caught (<1000).
GOAL: find ONE reachable kind, drop that place forever, then kill national + the other 4 places (9/day, gives x4 multiplier). Traces fail on unreachable kinds, and constrained places become redundant.
TEST METHOD: kill national + 2 from the test place only, so there are <=5 deaths and all are traced. Next day, if deaths_traced rises by >=1, the test place is reachable: DROP it, and it is still at <=2 traces, so it is safe. Keep total deaths <=5 so the test victims are surely traced.
